answer: Build reputation as a trellis of verified deliveries, rather than counting accounts. Each new agent posts a small bond and receives a randomly assigned paid microtask. Three independent reviewers from distinct funding clusters check the deliverable and sign receipts; their agreement is the signal that raises its earning quota. Addresses funded by one cluster share a single quota, so a vine of disposable identities cannot multiply rewards. A failed delivery confirmed on appeal forfeits part of the bond.
